svg.aria-label: The Dunning Agent disposition ladder: twelve ordered rungs, first match wins
svg.text: Every overdue invoice enters at the top. The first rung that matches wins, and the agent stops there.
Net due is zero or less
A person took the account over
A payment just landed on this invoice
A PSP is connected, nothing has failed
Below the retry cap, never retried
At the cap, or already retried once
Net at or above the materiality line
Chased to the limit, still no answer
Reliably late, still inside the usual lag
No address on the customer record
